svg.text: Curves enumerate candidate pairings between neighbouring columns for visual exploration only.

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif

svg.text: They do not encode execution order, proven compatibility, empirical frequency or a complete dependency graph.

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif

svg.text: * Refine before treating these terms as formal categories.

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif

svg.text: Separate model basis from scale; data direction from authority and feedback; agent roles from simulation models.

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif

svg.text: Separate timing guarantees, update triggers and rates. One-way is a Digital Shadow in Kritzinger et al. [R14].

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif

svg.text: [U] Exact descriptor not substantiated in this selected source set. Dashed borders identify these open items.

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif

svg.text: The six-family arrangement is proposed synthesis. References support terms or examples, not every connecting curve.
